step1_figure.description: A standard current mirror operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) with a single-ended output. It uses a differential pair with current mirror loads to provide high output impedance and gain.

equation.explanation: Product of total transconductance and output resistance

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming W/L=10 for all devices and Itail=20uA. Gm = gm1 = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) = 232 uA/V. Rout = ro6 || ro9 = 1/(lambda*I_D) || 1/(lambda*I_D) = 1/(0.1*10u) || 1/(0.1*10u) = 500 kOhm. Av = 232u * 500k = 116 V/V = 41.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact W/L sizing and resulting overdrive voltages.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where open-loop gain drops to 0 dB

equation.explanation: Determined by transconductance and load capacitance
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole is at the output

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales linearly with Gm and inversely with Cload.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Maximum current available to charge/discharge the load capacitor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to tail current and inversely to load capacitance.

equation.explanation: Sum of currents in all branches multiplied by supply voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact current mirror ratios and channel length modulation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, slew rate, and power dissipation of the Current Mirror OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* OTA testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

.param W_XM5=2u L_XM5=1u
.param W_XM4=2u L_XM4=1u
.param W_XM3=4u L_XM3=1u
.param W_XM0=4u L_XM0=1u
.param W_XM2=4u L_XM2=1u
.param W_XM1=4u L_XM1=1u
.param W_XM6=4u L_XM6=1u
.param W_XM7=4u L_XM7=1u
.param W_XM8=2u L_XM8=1u
.param W_XM9=2u L_XM9=1u

.subckt CURRENT_MIRROR_OTA VSS VDD VOUT VINN VINP ID
XM5 ID ID VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM5} l={L_XM5}
XM4 SOURCE ID VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM4} l={L_XM4}
XM3 NET7 VINN SOURCE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM3} l={L_XM3}
XM0 NET8 VINP SOURCE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM0} l={L_XM0}
XM2 NET7 NET7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM2} l={L_XM2}
XM1 NET8 NET8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM1} l={L_XM1}
XM6 VOUT NET7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM6} l={L_XM6}
XM7 NET9 NET8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM7} l={L_XM7}
XM8 NET9 NET9 SOURCE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM8} l={L_XM8}
XM9 VOUT NET9 SOURCE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM9} l={L_XM9}
.ends CURRENT_MIRROR_OTA

VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VSS VSS 0 DC 0
IBIAS VDD ID DC 20e-6

* Open-loop AC setup
VCM VCM 0 DC 0.9
VINP VINP VCM DC 0 AC 1
VINN VINN VCM DC 0 AC 0
XOTA VSS VDD VOUT VINN VINP ID CURRENT_MIRROR_OTA
CLOAD VOUT 0 1e-12

* Closed-loop Transient setup for Slew Rate
XOTA_TRAN VSS VDD VOUT_TRAN VOUT_TRAN VINP_TRAN ID CURRENT_MIRROR_OTA
CLOAD_TRAN VOUT_TRAN 0 1e-12
VINP_TRAN VINP_TRAN 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(0.4 1.4 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

  tran 100p 100n
  meas tran sr_rise deriv v(VOUT_TRAN) at=15n
  meas tran sr_fall deriv v(VOUT_TRAN) at=55n
  quit
.endc
.end
